question: Purna, Manjira and Pranhita are tributaries of:
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Godavari**__.

__
 
• **Purna, Manjira and Pranhita are tributaries of Godavari**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Godavari is India's second-longest river after Ganga and the third largest in India.

 
 
• It originates in Trimbakeshwar, Nashik, Maharashtra, and empties into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• **Geography of the river**: Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Odisha.
 
• **Major Right bank tributaries**: Pravara, Manjira, Manair, 
 
• **Major Left bank tributaries: **Purna, Pranahita, Indravati, Sabari.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Rivers**
 **Details**
 
 

 Indus
 
 
 
• The trans-Himalayan river originates in western Tibet.
 
• **Important tributaries**: Gilgit, Beas, Chenab, Jhelum, Ravi, Sutlej, Zaskar, Shyok.
 
 
 
 

 Chambal
 
 
 
• Chambal is a part of the greater Gangetic drainage system.
 
• It originates at Janapav, South of Mhow town on the south slope of the Vindhyan range in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is a tributary of the Yamuna river.
 
• **Important tributaries**: Parbati, Kali, Sindh, Shipra, Banas, Mej
 
 
 
 

 Yamuna
 
 
 
• It originates in Yamunotri Glacier, Uttarakhand.
 
• It is a tributary of the Ganga.
 
• **Important tributaries**: Hindon, ken, Chambal, Sindh, Tons, Betwa, Sasur Khadheri.
